library.name: std
library.description: The standard fragments shipped with RAICHU, written in the library format itself. Its version is the engine's: a standard fragment changes with the engine, and the expanded model records the engine version that supplied it.

fragments.name: bool_flow_in
fragments.description: A boolean input flow `<name>`: an in port `<name>_in` and the attribute `<name>_fed_in`, true while the connected sources feed it under `logic`.

parameters.name: logic
parameters.description: How the connected sources combine: all of them (and), any of them (or), or at least k of them (k). An input nothing feeds reads its default under every logic.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: The k of a k-out-of-n input.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: What the input reads while no connection feeds it.

fragments.name: bool_flow_out
fragments.description: A boolean output flow `<name>` produced under a condition: `<name>_fed_out` is true while the production condition holds and the output is available. The condition is a disjunction of conjunctions: a list of groups, each a list of attribute names of the instance, and the output is produced while every attribute of at least one group is true. `<name>_fed_available_out` is written by the modes only: a mode cuts it when it starts available, and wakes it when it starts unavailable.

parameters.name: prod_cond
parameters.description: Production condition: any of these groups, each all of its attributes (for example [["power_fed_in"]]).

parameters.name: fed_available_init
parameters.description: Whether the output starts available. A dormant service output starts unavailable and a compromise mode wakes it.

fragments.name: bool_source_out
fragments.description: A boolean output flow `<name>` with no production condition: a constant source, or a dormant function when `prod_init` is false. Nothing in the type writes `<name>_prod_available`, so a mode may activate (or cut) it.

parameters.name: prod_init
parameters.description: Whether the source produces from the start.

fragments.name: logic_gate
fragments.description: A logic gate `<name>`: a boolean input combining its sources under `logic`, re-exported on the out port `<name>_out`.

parameters.name: logic
parameters.description: How the connected sources combine: all of them (and), any of them (or), or at least k of them (k). An input nothing feeds reads its default under every logic.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: The k of a k-out-of-n input.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: What the input reads while no connection feeds it.

fragments.name: continuous_flow_out
fragments.description: A continuous output flow `<name>` of a conservative network: the out port `<name>_out` and the totals `<name>_demand_out` (what its consumers ask) and `<name>_fed_out` (what they receive). Each connection's claim is its consumer's demand truncated at the quantity distributed, and a distribution operator splits that quantity over the claims. What a consumer receives is its allocation scaled by the share it accepts. The capability `<name>_capability_out` is declared here and written by the fragment that makes the flow (`continuous_source`, `volume_outlet`, `rule_produces`, `tap`).

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: What the operator distributes: the capability (a source, a volume) or what a rule set actually produced, `<name>_produced_out`.

parameters.name: shares
parameters.description: For `shares`: one `{"to": {"component", "port"}, "value"}` per consumer, summing to 1.

parameters.name: held
parameters.description: Whether the flow leaves a volume: while that volume has run out, it passes on what arrives and a releasing consumer accepts it first.

parameters.name: empty_automaton
parameters.description: With `held`: the automaton whose `empty` state says the volume has run out of the flow.

fragments.name: continuous_flow_in
fragments.description: A continuous input flow `<name>` of a conservative network: the in port `<name>_in`, the capability `<name>_capability_in` its suppliers offer, and `<name>_fed_in`, what it receives. It publishes its demand `<name>_demand_in` (written by the fragment that consumes the flow) and the shares it accepts on every connection feeding it; the shares stay 1 unless `surplus_release` applies. An input no connection feeds receives zero.

fragments.name: surplus_release
fragments.description: Makes the input `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_in`) hand back what it does not need when two suppliers or more offer more than its demand, pro rata of what each offered. A supplier whose volume has run out (`held` on its `continuous_flow_out`) passes on what arrives and is accepted first; the others share what is left. With a single supplier both shares stay 1. Apply it to an input a rule set consumes and no volume holds.

fragments.name: continuous_source
fragments.description: Writes the capability of the output `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_out`) of a source: its rate, times the time profile `<name>_out_profile` when `profiled`.

fragments.name: continuous_sink
fragments.description: Writes the demand of the input `<name>` (a `continuous_flow_in`) of a consumer: its rate, times the time profile `<name>_in_profile` when `profiled`.

fragments.name: time_profile
fragments.description: A sinusoidal time profile written into the attribute `<target>`: max(value_min, amplitude sin(2 pi (t - phase_shift) / period) + offset).

parameters.name: initial
parameters.description: Initial value of the attribute (the profile at t = 0).

fragments.name: rate_publisher
fragments.description: Publishes a flow's rate on the out port `<name>_rate_out` (attribute `<name>_rate`): the capability of an output, or what an input receives.

fragments.name: volume_flow
fragments.description: One flow `<flow>` held in the volume `<volume>`: its content (an ODE: what arrives less what leaves), its fill fraction, and the demand of the input `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_in`), which asks its nominal demand plus the fill rate while the volume is not full and no more than leaves once it is. The volume's bounds come from `volume_total`; an outlet adds `volume_outlet`.

parameters.name: fill_rate
parameters.description: Rate the volume fills at on top of the demand.

parameters.name: outlet
parameters.description: Whether the flow also leaves the volume (a `volume_outlet`).

fragments.name: volume_outlet
fragments.description: Writes the capability of the output `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_out`) leaving the volume `<volume>`: its rate, bounded by what the volume serves, and by what arrives while the automaton `<empty_automaton>` is `empty`.

parameters.name: empty_automaton
parameters.description: Automaton whose `empty` state says the flow has run out.

fragments.name: volume_stock
fragments.description: An automaton `<volume>_stock_<flow>` (`empty`, `stocked`) following whether the volume `<volume>` holds any of the flow `<flow>`: what a multi-flow volume tests per flow.

fragments.name: volume_total
fragments.description: The volume `<volume>` holding the flows `<flows>` (each a `volume_flow`): its total content and fill, the bounds automaton `<volume>_bounds` (`empty`, `partial`, `full`) on the total, and the share of each flow listed in `ratio_flows`.

parameters.name: ratio_flows
parameters.description: Flows whose share of the content is published as `<volume>_ratio_<flow>`.

fragments.name: rule_set
fragments.description: A rule set `<name>` with one producing rule `<active>` and one idle rule `<idle>`: the automaton `<name>_mode` runs `<active>` while every boolean input in `conditions` is fed (and, with a `band` threshold, while the capability of `<threshold_flow>` has reached `activate` and not fallen below `release`). The rule's scale is the largest fraction of its nominal rates the inputs' capabilities allow (`<name>_capability_scale`), bounded by what the outputs are asked (`<name>_scale`) and by what actually arrives (`<name>_draw_scale`). Each consumed flow is a `rule_consumes`, each produced one a `rule_produces`.

parameters.name: capped
parameters.description: Produced flows with a maximum rate (`rule_produces` with `capped`).

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: Boolean inputs (`bool_flow_in`) that must all be fed.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: An optional band on the capability of `threshold_flow`.

parameters.name: threshold_flow
parameters.description: With `band`: the input whose capability is compared.

parameters.name: activate
parameters.description: With `band`: the capability at which the rule starts (>=).

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: With `band`: the capability under which it stops (<).

fragments.name: rule_consumes
fragments.description: The producing rule `<active>` of the rule set `<rule_set>` consumes the input `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_in`) at `rate` per unit of scale: it writes the input's demand.

fragments.name: rule_produces
fragments.description: The producing rule `<active>` of the rule set `<rule_set>` produces the output `<flow>` (a `continuous_flow_out` with `available: produced`) at `rate` per unit of scale: its capability at the capability scale and `<flow>_produced_out` at the draw scale, bounded by `max_rate` when `capped`. With `tapped`, they are written before a `tap` takes its leaks (`<flow>_pre_tap_capability_out`, `<flow>_pre_tap_produced_out`).

parameters.name: capped
parameters.description: Whether the output has a maximum rate.

parameters.name: tapped
parameters.description: Whether a `tap` takes leaks from the output.

fragments.name: tap
fragments.description: Leaks taken from the output `<flow>` (a `rule_produces` with `tapped`) into the outputs `<outlets>` (each a `continuous_flow_out` with `available: produced`): outlet `o` takes the fraction `<o>_pct` (0 by default, the attribute a failure mode targets) and the output keeps `<flow>_tap_rate`, one less their sum.

fragments.name: aggregate_measure
fragments.description: A measured quantity `<name>`: the sum of what is connected to the in port `<name>_in`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Measure name (an attribute and its in port).

fragments.name: threshold_compare
fragments.description: A boolean output `<name>` (out port `<name>_out`), true while the attribute `<input>` compares to `<name>_threshold` under `operator`, the crossing located exactly; `<name>_signal_available` false forces it false.

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Comparison that makes the output true.

fragments.name: threshold_band
fragments.description: A boolean output `<name>` (out port `<name>_out`) with a hysteresis band on the attribute `<input>`: `below` turns it true when the input falls to `activate` and false when it rises above `release`; `above` the other way round. `<name>_signal_available` false forces it false.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Side of the band that activates.
